truths.truth: A prompt-line hit given a share of 0 to 3 characters, whose text is longer than its share, shows as ...; that turn is not recorded as injected, so a later prompt can quote it; the brief's output is unchanged
truths.evidence: The recording half holds, but the display half fails at a lone turn's share of 0, 1 or 2. Observed on target/debug/terminus (built 7 s after b200aac) with tests/fixtures/session-edits.jsonl ingested and the prompt 'what changed in crates/gizmo/lantern.rs'. The frame costs 239 characters and the bare line 23. Each budget below ran under its own session, as [injection] prompt_chars. Budget 262 (spare 0) gives '- turn 1 (2026-08-13...'. 263 gives '- turn 1 (2026-08-13)...'. 264 gives '- turn 1 (2026-08-13):...'. Only 265 (spare 3) gives '- turn 1 (2026-08-13): ...', and 266 gives ': r...'. So at shares 0 to 2 the turn's text is never '...'. The mark is frame's backstop clip (inject/mod.rs:180-191, 456-462) cutting the line's own separator, and at share 0 its date. Before 5242337 the spare-0 line kept its date and separator whole with an empty text. Recording: decisions.injected is [] at 262-265 and [{turn_id:1,chars:4}] at 266, and no state file exists for the 262-265 sessions. Session 262, asked again at the default budget, quotes 'replacing lanternFlicker...'. a_turn_shown_as_the_mark_alone_is_not_remembered_and_can_be_quoted_later passes. brief.rs and inject_brief.rs have no diff across 758ebb5^..05917c6. The tests are built around the deviation. prompt.rs a_cut_the_share_cannot_hold_is_shown_as_the_mark tests a lone turn only at spare 3, though PLAN-5 task 1 asks for shares 0, 1, 2 and 3. In the inject_prompt.rs sweep, turn_lines returns None for a line the backstop cut and the loop continues (lines 840, 868), so those budgets are never asserted on. Against ROADMAP criterion 5's narrow wording ('a cut mark rather than a bare fragment'), shares 1 and 2 do end in '...' and carry no excerpt fragment. AC6 ('shows as ...') and PLAN-5's must-have are not met. By clip's arithmetic, not observed: when several turns are all marked, the backstop takes the overspend plus 3 characters off the last line, and for an undated hit that cuts the turn id, the case D-17 was revised to avoid.

gaps.name: Stray println!/eprintln! fails clippy; no per-field escapes left
gaps.reason: unwired - the print lints are denied only in the lib crate root, so main.rs, the bin's own crate root inside crates/terminus/src, is not covered
gaps.evidence: lib.rs:13 #![cfg_attr(not(test), deny(clippy::print_stdout, clippy::print_stderr))] applies to the lib crate only. main.rs has no deny, and neither crates/terminus/Cargo.toml nor the workspace Cargo.toml has [lints.clippy]. In a scratch copy of HEAD, println! and eprintln! added to main.rs's fn main pass `cargo clippy --locked -p terminus --bins` with exit 0 after 'Checking terminus'. The same eprintln! in cmd/status.rs fails naming print_stderr. The escape::controls half of the item holds: it is called only from out.rs.
gaps.missing: Add #![deny(clippy::print_stdout, clippy::print_stderr)] to crates/terminus/src/main.rs (it has no test module, so no cfg_attr is needed). Then confirm a throwaway println! in main.rs fails `cargo clippy --locked -p terminus --bins`.

gaps.name: Prompt-line cut to a share of 0-3 shows as ... and is not recorded
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - at a lone turn's share of 0 to 2 (a budget that cannot hold the ids, dates and marks), frame's backstop cuts the turn's line instead of the turn showing '...'. This is plan 5's recorded deviation, which follows the revised D-17, but AC6 and PLAN-5's must-have were not revised with it. The recording half is right.
gaps.evidence: crates/terminus-core/src/inject/prompt.rs:295-311 marks the turn and texts it '...'. Then prompt.rs:329 frame() clips the assembled lines (inject/mod.rs:180-191, 456-462), which drops the line's ': ' separator and at share 0 the date's closing parenthesis. Observed on the binary with session-edits.jsonl (frame 239, bare line 23): budget 262 gives '- turn 1 (2026-08-13...', 263 gives '- turn 1 (2026-08-13)...', 264 gives '- turn 1 (2026-08-13):...', and only 265 gives '- turn 1 (2026-08-13): ...'. ROADMAP criterion 5's narrow wording is met at shares 1 and 2 (a '...', no excerpt fragment), but AC6's 'shows as ...' is not, and share 0 now cuts a date that printed whole before 5242337. The tests avoid the case: prompt.rs a_cut_the_share_cannot_hold_is_shown_as_the_mark checks a lone turn only at spare 3, though PLAN-5 task 1 asks for shares 0-3, and the sweep's turn_lines (tests/inject_prompt.rs:862-871) returns None for a backstop-cut line, which the loop skips at line 840. Reachable only with [injection] prompt_chars set within 2 characters of frame plus ids plus dates for the hits that fire (config.rs:540 has no floor). The default 4000 never reaches it, the budget always holds, and nothing is wrongly recorded.
gaps.missing: John's call between two fixes. (a) Keep AC6: in render, when the ids, dates and marks alone are over what the frame leaves, drop whole trailing turns (unrecorded) until the rest fit, so no turn line ever reaches frame's backstop. Then add the lone-turn share 0, 1 and 2 cases to a_cut_the_share_cannot_hold_is_shown_as_the_mark, and make the inject_prompt sweep fail on a backstop-cut turn line instead of skipping it. (b) Keep D-17 as shipped: reword AC6 and ROADMAP criterion 5 to say that at a budget that cannot hold the ids plus the marks, the backstop cuts the line and the turn is not recorded, and make docs/design/0007-injection.md:122 say what that cut does to the line.

gaps.name: compact --json reads an unreadable data directory as no store and answers ok: true
gaps.reason: behavior wrong (pre-existing, 970f2c4) - Path::exists swallows the permission error, so compact says there is no store when there is one it cannot read. That breaks AC3's own example of how to make each --json command fail, and the goal's 'say what they really do'.
gaps.evidence: crates/terminus/src/cmd/compact.rs:45 `if !data_dir.join(DB_FILE_NAME).exists()` returns read::empty(..) with 'no terminus store at <dir>; there is nothing to reclaim'. On target/debug/terminus with a chmod 000 data directory holding a real store, `compact --json` exits 0 with ok:true, and human `compact` exits 0. The other 13 data commands answer the same directory with exit 1 and ok:false 'cannot read the terminus store'. The phase did not touch this line (git blame: 970f2c4, 2026-08-22).
gaps.missing: In compact, use Path::try_exists (or read::open's own rule) so a permission error is Failure::Operational, which main turns into the empty document with ok: false under --json. Add the unreadable-directory case for compact to tests/cli.rs. Or, if it is left for later, file it as an issue rather than fixing it in this phase.
